description: This file defines the QuicChromiumClientStream class, a client-initiated reliable QUIC stream implementation, including its nested Handle class, methods for header and data management, and connection control features within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: QuicChromiumClientStream
classes.description: Represents a client-initiated reliable QUIC stream, managing headers, data transfer, and connection state within Chromium's network stack.

classes.name: QuicChromiumClientStream::Handle
classes.description: A restricted interface for interacting with a QuicChromiumClientStream, allowing header and data operations, connection status checks, and error handling.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates a new handle for this stream, used for controlled access.

methods.name: ClearHandle
methods.description: Removes the associated handle from the stream.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Notifies the stream of an error without closing it.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, returning the number of bytes read.

methods.name: DisableConnectionMigrationToCellularNetwork
methods.description: Prevents the stream from migrating to a cellular network.

methods.name: IsFirstStream
methods.description: Checks if this is the first data stream on the session.

methods.name: DeliverEarlyHints
methods.description: Delivers early hints headers to the handle.

methods.name: DeliverInitialHeaders
methods.description: Delivers initial headers to the handle.

methods.name: DeliverTrailingHeaders
methods.description: Delivers trailing headers to the handle.
